ar: *Central Ithilien....once a land of Gondor, its people fled in fear when the Nazgul returned to Mordor and made Minas Morgul their home.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_PelInt1subtitle
en: *Pelargir, the city through which all sea trade enters Gondor. For ages, men have coveted this port.
ar: *Pelargir, the city through which all sea trade enters Gondor. For ages, men have coveted this port.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_PelInt2subtitle
en: *It is this city through which all sea trade enters Gondor. For ages, men have coveted this port.
ar: *It is this city through which all sea trade enters Gondor. For ages, men have coveted this port.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_ArnInt1subtitle
en: *Emyn Arnen....the Royal Hills, home of the descendents of the Stewards of Gondor. Their ancestors knew only peace. Now they will know only war.
ar: *Emyn Arnen....the Royal Hills, home of the descendents of the Stewards of Gondor. Their ancestors knew only peace. Now they will know only war.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_ArnInt2subtitle
en: *These hills were once the home of great men of Gondor. They knew only peace. Their descendents shall know only war.
ar: *These hills were once the home of great men of Gondor. They knew only peace. Their descendents shall know only war.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_SIthIntsubtitle
en: *Southern Ithilien marks the border of the lands of Gondor and those of the Haradrim. A contested realm where all are in danger.
ar: *Southern Ithilien marks the border of the lands of Gondor and those of the Haradrim. A contested realm where all are in danger.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_NearIntsubtitle
en: *Near Harad...a hot and exotic land. It is the kingdom of the Haradrim, warriors loyal to Sauron.
ar: *Near Harad...a hot and exotic land. It is the kingdom of the Haradrim, warriors loyal to Sauron.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_GonInt1subtitle
en: *The villages of Gondor now shelter the weak. Their burning homes will blacken the sky.
ar: *The villages of Gondor now shelter the weak. Their burning homes will blacken the sky.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_GonInt2subtitle
en: *Gondor was once a thriving land of men. It shall now be their burial place.
ar: *Gondor was once a thriving land of men. It shall now be their burial place.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_GonInt3subtitle
en: *Only Gondor lies between Mordor and the lands beyond. Once it falls, all of Middle-earth shall be Sauron's.
ar: *Only Gondor lies between Mordor and the lands beyond. Once it falls, all of Middle-earth shall be Sauron's.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_MorInt1subtitle
en: *The plains of Mordor lie in darkness....the eternal shadow of the Dark Lord Sauron.
ar: *The plains of Mordor lie in darkness....the eternal shadow of the Dark Lord Sauron.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_MorInt2subtitle
en: *Mordor, a land of fire and ash. All who enter here will know nothing but pain and death.
ar: *Mordor, a land of fire and ash. All who enter here will know nothing but pain and death.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_MorInt3subtitle
en: *Mordor - the domain of Sauron. Those who enter must serve Sauron or perish.
ar: *Mordor - the domain of Sauron. Those who enter must serve Sauron or perish.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_RohInt1subtitle
en: *Rohan, the lands of the Horse-Lords. Soon these lands will have a new master.
ar: *Rohan, the lands of the Horse-Lords. Soon these lands will have a new master.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_RohInt2subtitle
en: *The farmlands of Rohan were once a place of peace and harmony. They will now be a land of enslavement and misery.
ar: *The farmlands of Rohan were once a place of peace and harmony. They will now be a land of enslavement and misery.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_RohInt3subtitle
en: *Rohan's hills have been the domain of Men and Kings for ages. They shall now be ruled by the armies of Sauron.
ar: *Rohan's hills have been the domain of Men and Kings for ages. They shall now be ruled by the armies of Sauron.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEWorld_RohInt4subtitle
en: *The villages of Rohan believe they are protected by the powerful horsemen of Rohan. But nothing can shelter them from the darkness that approaches.
ar: *The villages of Rohan believe they are protected by the powerful horsemen of Rohan. But nothing can shelter them from the darkness that approaches.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGIntro_Gala001subtitle
en: *The Battle for Middle-earth is about to begin
ar: *The Battle for Middle-earth is about to begin

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGDefea_Gala001subtitle
en: *The shadow has overtaken the light. It must not be allowed to extinguish.
ar: *The shadow has overtaken the light. It must not be allowed to extinguish.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGDefea_Gala002subtitle
en: *The free people have fallen into shadow.
ar: *The free people have fallen into shadow.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGDefea_Gala003subtitle
en: *Sauron's shadow falls further over the land.
ar: *Sauron's shadow falls further over the land.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGDefea_Gala004subtitle
en: *The quest has fallen to the ruin of all.
ar: *The quest has fallen to the ruin of all.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGDefea_Gala005subtitle
en: *The footsteps of doom sound. A great evil grows.
ar: *The footsteps of doom sound. A great evil grows.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGDefea_Gala006subtitle
en: *Our warriors were brave, but their numbers too small.
ar: *Our warriors were brave, but their numbers too small.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGDefea_Gala007subtitle
en: *The banners are torn, and the dead lie heavy on the earth.
ar: *The banners are torn, and the dead lie heavy on the earth.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGDefea_Gala008subtitle
en: *No man, Elf or Dwarf yet stands. Our enemy is victorious.
ar: *No man, Elf or Dwarf yet stands. Our enemy is victorious.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGDefea_Gala010subtitle
en: *Those who fight for peace and freedom have lost, and fear chills the land.
ar: *Those who fight for peace and freedom have lost, and fear chills the land.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGVicto_Gala004subtitle
en: *Elves will sing of this glorious day.
ar: *Elves will sing of this glorious day.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGVicto_Gala005subtitle
en: *Valor and honor have taken this day.
ar: *Valor and honor have taken this day.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGVicto_Gala008subtitle
en: *Brave warriors have slain the forces of evil.
ar: *Brave warriors have slain the forces of evil.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MGVicto_Gala010subtitle
en: *The darkness has been chased from the lands of the innocent.
ar: *The darkness has been chased from the lands of the innocent.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEIntro_Saru001subtitle
en: *The Battle for Middle-earth is about to begin.
ar: *The Battle for Middle-earth is about to begin.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEDefea_Saru001subtitle
en: *The forces of evil are defeated...this cannot be!
ar: *The forces of evil are defeated...this cannot be!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEDefea_Saru002subtitle
en: *Sauron's revenge for this defeat will be swift and strong!
ar: *Sauron's revenge for this defeat will be swift and strong!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEDefea_Saru004subtitle
en: *A battle lost is not the war.
ar: *A battle lost is not the war.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEDefea_Saru006subtitle
en: *The free peoples should not be underestimated.
ar: *The free peoples should not be underestimated.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEDefea_Saru007subtitle
en: *The cursed enemies have won the day.
ar: *The cursed enemies have won the day.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEDefea_Saru008subtitle
en: *The tide has turned against the rising darkness.
ar: *The tide has turned against the rising darkness.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEDefea_Saru009subtitle
en: *There is still some strength in men. It will be crushed soon enough.
ar: *There is still some strength in men. It will be crushed soon enough.

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEVicto_Saru003subtitle
en: *We shall vanquish all who oppose Sauron!
ar: *We shall vanquish all who oppose Sauron!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEVicto_Saru005subtitle
en: *Let all the world fear the darkness!
ar: *Let all the world fear the darkness!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEVicto_Saru006subtitle
en: *A new power is rising. Victory is at hand!
ar: *A new power is rising. Victory is at hand!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEVicto_Saru007subtitle
en: *The land has been stained with the blood of men!
ar: *The land has been stained with the blood of men!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEVicto_Saru008subtitle
en: *There will be no dawn for men!
ar: *There will be no dawn for men!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MEVicto_Saru009subtitle
en: *Against the power of Sauron there can be no victory!
ar: *Against the power of Sauron there can be no victory!

label: SUBTITLE:MGLothl_ElvenOfficer010
en: The enemy breached the northwest perimeter.
ar: The enemy breached the northwest perimeter.

label: SUBTITLE:MENearH_Hara040
en: From this day forth, we fight for Sauron!
ar: From this day forth, we fight for Sauron!
